notes: The list already covers the core solo works, keyboard and continuo sonatas and concertos. What was missing were the doubtful or alternative chamber works (BWV 1020, 1024, 1025, 1036, 1037), the concertos where the violin is one of three soloists (BWV 1044 and Brandenburg No. 5), and a few Suzuki-school arrangements.
